analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,495,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,605,000 KRW) / SMA20 (1,763,500 KRW) / SMA50 (2,140,913 KRW) — Below short-term and mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,708,120 KRW) / SMA200 (1,197,995 KRW) — Below long-term trends, showing bearish dominance.
· 52-week position (42.7%) + Current price level is in a rebound phase from the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.8→40.6) — Attempting to exit oversold territory, weak rebound momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-68424.2144→-8545.8787) — Weak convergence continues, improvement confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band 1,304,414 KRW) — Approaching the lower band, potential for bounce.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (1,246,000 KRW) — Based on the 20-day low, a key support level.
· Swing Resistance (1,995,000 KRW) — Upside breakout above this level expected to signal an uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low 1,481,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,246,000 KRW, 5-day high 1,718,000 KRW, 20-day high 2,305,000 KRW. Higher 5-day low and lower 5-day high indicate entry into a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.79x) — Contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Lack of clear direction, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
